business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Consumer digital healthcare platform: prescription discount coupons, pharmacy-benefit-manager fee revenue, subscriptions, pharma manufacturer solutions and telehealth

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Consumer-facing marketplace and transaction platform earning fees from PBMs and pharma advertisers, plus subscriptions

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Fee per prescription fill from pharmacy benefit managers; monthly subscription fees; pharma advertising and sponsorship fees

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Mostly repeat, usage-driven prescription fees from PBM contracts, with smaller subscription and manufacturer advertising revenue

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Consumer web and mobile app platform, cloud-delivered

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Healthcare price comparison, prescription savings and telehealth consumer marketplace

processing_transaction_platform_7374.label: Processing / transaction platform [7374]
processing_transaction_platform_7374.value: Prescription price-discount transaction routing through pharmacy benefit manager networks and pharmacies

advertising_agency_economics_731.label: Advertising / agency economics [731]
